parent.negative: F124-DI FIT-only structural prior matched independent control but slower than simpler degree4 trained baseline; no new science first-use

question: Can causal-bit orbit invariance be identified from unchanged FIT trajectories and reused to predict new source-target event histories at less complete native cost than equally informed strong trained symmetry-aware learner?
learner: FIT-local 20/4 episode heldout selects shared 10-term cyclic bit orbit vs 4 untied 10-term bit predictors; both classes learned exactly with GF2 rank elimination; full 24 episode refit; natural CHECK veto, no CHECK label training
primary_strong_peer: Independently implemented FIT-local selection between identical shared/untied 10-term binary causal bases with identical full 20/4 local split, full 24 FIT refit, equivalent rank/zero-free-variable solution, identical input/label budget
secondary_control: Fully trained independent untied 4-output 10-feature basis, no privileged symmetry selection, separate baseline not equal CV information
out_of_class: modular addition carrying bit interactions; expected to fail linear orbit class and preserve negatives
measurement: Two source-free families plus out-of-class ×4 fixed development seeds ×3 arms×3 independent whole Linux Python process samples=108 complete OS observations; deterministic same public FIT/CHECK/heldout identities, preserve natural FIT/CHECK failures; independently read-only aggregate
decision: For meaningful evidence require CHECK admitted >=3/4 per supported symmetry family, >=24/32 exact heldout positives, zero admitted hard false positives, no worse whole OS CPU+RSS than independently trained symmetry-aware peer. Failure is retained; do not optimize on sourcefree heldout outcomes.
limits: Known orbit-basis and linear features are supplied equally; this is synthetic prior-feasibility only, not discovery of arbitrary unknown causal symmetries or external original science.
